## Description

<big>Enables or disables jump for one or more players.</big>

## Snippet

```
Set Jump Enabled(Event Player, True);
```

## Properties

**Returns**: _<span style="color: #c678dd">Void</span>_
**Parameters**: ==_Player_==, ==_Enabled_==

> ==**Player**==
> _Type: **[Player](/wiki/articles/player)** | **Array** (**Player**), Default: **[Event Player](/wiki/articles/event+player)**_
> The player or players whose access to jump is affected.

> ==**Enabled**==
> _Type: **Boolean**, Default: **[True](/wiki/articles/true)**_
> Specifies whether the player or players are able to use jump. Expects a boolean value such as true, false, or compare.
